paper_title: Super Strong ETH Is True for PPSZ with Small Resolution Width
statement: We constructed close to tight hard instances for the PPSZ algorithm which uses bounded width resolution to derive values and showed that the savings can be at most (1+)2k . Several questions of various levels interest remain open. The first one is to obtain Super Strong ETH hard instance for resolution of larger width, ideally as close to m/ log(m) as possible. Even for the weak heuristic, the hard instances from [9] hold for subformulas of size up to mO(1) . The next problem is determining the precise constant in the savings of PPSZ.
